source.prediction_mechanism: Use unchanged K4I raw 1-NN armwise predictor and K4K original frozen 4-per-arm FIT-only coresets; no new selectors

cohort.actual_action_menu: K4H frozen low, mid, high, even20/odd80 joint positions
cohort.source_world_constructor: K4H source-supported public goal shifts, no hidden state, same reset before each action, independent action episodes

training: Same exact 12 new FIT contexts/4 legal action outcomes per family for all fitted methods, no heldout reward for fit; original FIT-only code frozen K4K.
observe: Public structured reset observation ONLY; freeze CHECK/DEV policy choices before obtaining any heldout rewards.
stop: If reaching FIT does not have 12 unique public contexts AND ≥2 actual best action IDs, stop without consuming CHECK/DEV; retain FIT negative.
action_diversity: For each family, report realized best legal arm per DEV context as offline diagnostic only; at least 2 distinct best-arm IDs on reaching DEV is necessary but not sufficient. Never feed this hindsight into predictors.

primary_requirements.quality: Compressed outcome_aware_4 vs fully FIT-trained family_mean: mean reaching DEV advantage≥0.01 and ≥3 of 8 contexts with strictly higher REAL public return; retain ≥90% of full_12's positive mean advantage.
primary_requirements.uniqueness: Compressed outcome_aware_4 mean reaching DEV reward exceeds conventional coverage_4 by ≥0.01. Report full_12, uniform_4, ridge separately. Coverage is matched 4 exemplars/arm and same predictor.
primary_requirements.decision_heterogeneity: At least two distinct actions selected by outcome_aware_4 across eight novel reaching contexts, and actual DEV hindsight winner actions have ≥2 IDs (diagnostic sufficiency).
primary_requirements.resource: Outcome-aware coreset saved original training exemplars bytes ≤0.50 of full_12 and repeated inference CPU ≤0.65 of full_12 (200 fixed ordered repeats on all 20 read-only heldout CHECK/DEV contexts, per-method CPU measured separately); both fresh OS processes individually must pass.
primary_requirements.confirmation: Two fresh Python processes on same GitHub runner must match byte-normalized source science and both meet preregistered quality/cost decision. No independent-host claim.

resource_accounting: One original shared FIT+CHECK+DEV simulator CPU/wall/RSS + shared training CPU/wall and per-policy inference CPU/wall and saved payload bytes. Measurement overhead recorded; do not claim total per-method physics cost.
negatives: No post hoc changes to world configurations, action set, observation features, model selection, memory criteria, information gates or thresholds, no reusing consumed K4K DEV cohorts; freeze all original positives and negatives.
